question: What effect follows from always contemplating the triple world as smoke-colored?
premises: The triple world is to be contemplated as smoke-colored.
This contemplation is to be done always.
The result is the ability to shake the triple world.
inference: By always contemplating the triple world as smoke-colored, one may shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating the triple world as smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
